<insights>

- High coupling (0.6) — 118 imports target "core-schema"
- 63 entry points — wide API surface, consider consolidating exports
- Zone "core" has files across 10 directories — consider consolidating under a dedicated directory
- "Core" imports "Core Cli" on 6 edge(s) while the 43 edge(s) between them run the other way — the minority direction looks like a layering violation
- "packages/core/src/index.ts" is imported from 6 zones (core-document, tests-core-document, tests-core-integration, tests-core-support, tests-core-unit, tests-packages) — a cross-cutting dependency every one of them is coupled to
- "packages/core/src/check.ts" is imported from 3 zones (tests-core-document, tests-core-integration, tests-core-unit) — a cross-cutting dependency every one of them is coupled to
- "packages/core/src/days.ts" is imported from 5 zones (core-cli, core-document, core-invariants, core-mutations, core-schema) — a cross-cutting dependency every one of them is coupled to
- "packages/core/src/check.ts" is production code imported only by tests (125 importer(s), all test files) — either it is dead or its real caller is missing
- "packages/core/src/describe.ts" is production code imported only by tests (26 importer(s), all test files) — either it is dead or its real caller is missing
- "packages/core/src/blocks.ts" is production code imported only by tests (25 importer(s), all test files) — either it is dead or its real caller is missing
- [call graph] 1285 internal calls, 307 outgoing, 3591 incoming (cohesion: 0.81, coupling: 0.19)
- The zone is a flat barrel of ~60 top-level files whose headers each justify being a separate entry (arrange, blocks, catalog, sync...); the entry list is effectively a bundle-budget partition, so 'consolidate exports' would break the hosted-page budget. New files should pick an entry deliberately, not be added to index.ts.
- apps/spike/vite.config.ts and packages/core/scripts/write-document-schema.mjs are grouped into this zone only by path/name proximity; they are build tooling, not part of the runtime API, and inflate the 'core' file count and directory spread.
- check.ts, describe.ts and blocks.ts are reached in production through package.json exports (subpath entries) and the CLI, not through intra-package imports, so the 'only imported by tests' insights reflect public entries rather than dead code.

</insights>
